## Summary and change classification

- [ ] software-only
- [ ] numerical algorithm
- [ ] physical model
- [ ] workflow semantics
- [ ] documentation
- [ ] governance

## Architecture

- [ ] Frozen architecture preserved, or architecture impact explicitly documented.
- [ ] Dependency direction and public compatibility reviewed.

## Scientific integrity

- [ ] No invented engineering values.
- [ ] Assumptions and validity range documented (or explicitly not applicable).
- [ ] Sources/provenance recorded; no copied restricted source/data.

## Verification and validation

- [ ] Unit tests.
- [ ] Regression tests.
- [ ] Analytic/manufactured/independent reference cases.
- [ ] Negative/failure tests.
- [ ] Convergence studies for discretizations; deterministic seeded runs where applicable.
- [ ] Validation distinguished from software/numerical verification.

Evidence links, commands, results and limitations:

## Quality

- [ ] Full pytest.
- [ ] Ruff.
- [ ] Mypy.
- [ ] GUI tests where applicable.
- [ ] Required hosted checks green on the reviewed revision.
- [ ] No secrets or confidential/export-restricted information included.

## Claims and approval

- [ ] No unsupported flight/certification/production qualification claim introduced.
- [ ] Deferred capabilities explicitly marked and not advertised as operational.
- [ ] Authorized COSMOS owner approval recorded before merge (solo owner may self-review).
